title: Non-standard selection behaviour when editing item in Tree
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.stable.mono.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3570K CPU @ 3.40GHz (4 threads)

### Issue description

While renaming some nodes I noticed that the UX feeling was somehow not right.

When Tree's item is selected for editing the item's text and some other item is clicked, the original item pops out from the editing mode. But the other item that was clicked is not selected. The original item keeps being selected. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/088c2d46-d1b6-4158-9d73-030a8937d2e1

This is not a "standard" behaviour and by that I mean at least neither Windows file explorer nor Linux Mint's file manager do work this way. When another item is clicked, it is selected even if the current item is in edit mode. Example from Win 11:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2e8831bb-6d3d-4d1e-b7bc-19701ba6c22a

I'm sure it is possible to find counter examples which work the same way as Godot now. For example I don't have a Mac so I don't how this works in OSX. If the major operating systems do have different UX standards for this (Linux distro's probably have many...), then it would nice if the Tree worked using the operating system's way, so that e.g. in Windows clicking another item would always select that item.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Double click item in tree --> item enter edit mode
2. Click another item in tree -->  **another item is not selected**

N/A
